concept: Variance of a discrete random variable

prompt:
$X$ has probability density function $f(x)=kx^{2}$ for $0\le x\le3$ (and 0 otherwise).

**(a)** Find $k$. **[2]**

**(b)** Find $P(X>2)$. **[1]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $\displaystyle\int_0^3kx^{2}\,dx=9k=1$ **(M1)**, $k=\dfrac19$ **(A1)**

**(b)** $\displaystyle\int_2^3\frac{x^{2}}{9}dx=\frac{27-8}{27}=\frac{19}{27}$ **(A1)**

For a continuous variable, probabilities are areas; $P(X=2)=0$.

concept: Mode and median of a continuous random variable
prompt: For $f(x)=\dfrac{x^{2}}{9}$, $0\le x\le3$, find **(a)** the mode and **(b)** the median of $X$.
markscheme:
**(a)** $f$ is increasing on $[0,3]$, so the mode (where $f$ is greatest) is $x=3$ **(A1)**

**(b)** $\displaystyle\int_0^m\frac{x^{2}}{9}dx=\frac{m^{3}}{27}=\frac12$ **(M1)**, $m=\dfrac{3}{\sqrt[3]2}\approx2.38$ **(A1)**

concept: Mean and variance of a continuous random variable

markscheme:
$E(2X+3)=2\cdot\tfrac94+3=7.5$ **(A1)**

$\operatorname{Var}(2X+3)=4\cdot\tfrac{27}{80}=1.35$ **(A1)** — the $+3$ shifts but does not spread the distribution.
